gloss: to call out to, to appeal to

definitions.explanation: To speak out or address someone by calling their name or making a sound to get their attention.
To make an earnest request or plea to a person or group, often publicly, to take action or support something.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}に{呼|よ}びかけた。
examples.english: I called out to my friend.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろから{名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}びかけられた。
examples.english: Someone called out my name from behind.

examples.japanese: {見|み}つけたら{声|こえ}をかけて{呼|よ}びかけてください。
examples.english: If you find them, please call out to them.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}で{知|し}らない{人|ひと}に{呼|よ}びかけられて{振|ふ}り{向|む}いた。
examples.english: A stranger called out to me on the street and I turned around.

examples.japanese: {迷子|まいご}の{子|こ}どもに{優|やさ}しく{呼|よ}びかけたが、{泣|な}いていて{返事|へんじ}がなかった。
examples.english: I gently called out to the lost child, but they were crying and didn't respond.

examples.japanese: {節電|せつでん}を{呼|よ}びかけた。
examples.english: They urged people to save electricity.

examples.japanese: {市長|しちょう}が{市民|しみん}に{協力|きょうりょく}を{呼|よ}びかけた。
examples.english: The mayor appealed to citizens for cooperation.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{国民|こくみん}に{冷静|れいせい}な{対応|たいおう}を{呼|よ}びかけている。
examples.english: The government is urging citizens to respond calmly.

examples.japanese: ボランティアの{参加|さんか}を{呼|よ}びかけるポスターが{貼|は}ってあった。
examples.english: There was a poster calling for volunteer participation.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}を{守|まも}るために、{一人|ひとり}ひとりが{行動|こうどう}を{変|か}えるよう{呼|よ}びかける{運動|うんどう}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: A movement calling on each person to change their behavior to protect the environment is spreading.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB: {呼|よ}ぶ (to call) + かける (to direct toward) = to call out toward someone

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. Takes に to mark the person being addressed or appealed to.

CONJUGATION PATTERNS:
・{呼|よ}びかけて (te-form)
・{呼|よ}びかけた (past)
・{呼|よ}びかけられる (passive/potential)
・{呼|よ}びかけ (noun form: appeal, call)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{注意|ちゅうい}を{呼|よ}びかける (to call for caution)
・{協力|きょうりょく}を{呼|よ}びかける (to appeal for cooperation)
・{参加|さんか}を{呼|よ}びかける (to call for participation)
・{節電|せつでん}を{呼|よ}びかける (to urge energy conservation)
・{名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}びかける (to call out someone's name)

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
・{呼|よ}び{止|と}める - to call out and stop someone
・{呼|よ}び{出|だ}す - to summon, to call out
・{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる - to call over, to summon
